THETAILOR-STITCH.title: Stitch
THETAILOR-STITCH.description: Link two non-[gold]Stitched[/gold] cards. When one is played, the other is played afterward for free.
THETAILOR-STITCHED.title: Stitched
THETAILOR-STITCHED.description: Linked to another card. When this card is played, the other is played afterward for free.
THETAILOR-DELICATE.title: Delicate
THETAILOR-DELICATE.description: When played, reduce this card's [gold]Delicate[/gold] by 1. [gold]Exhausts[/gold] when it reaches 0.
THETAILOR-CONVERT.title: Convert
THETAILOR-CONVERT.description: Replaces a Minion while keeping its max HP.
THETAILOR-PREMIUM.title: Premium
THETAILOR-PREMIUM.description: Can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold] any number of times.
THETAILOR-LEATHERMINION.title: Leather Minion
THETAILOR-LEATHERMINION.description: [gold]6 HP[/gold]. Takes unblocked attack damage for you.
THETAILOR-LINENMINION.title: Linen Minion
THETAILOR-LINENMINION.description:
[gold]5 HP[/gold]. Takes unblocked attack damage for you.
When hit, applies 2 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to its attacker.
THETAILOR-COTTONMINION.title: Cotton Minion
THETAILOR-COTTONMINION.description:
[gold]3 HP[/gold]. Takes unblocked attack damage for you.
At the end of your turn, heals you for 1 HP and takes 1 damage.
THETAILOR-DENIMMINION.title: Denim Minion
THETAILOR-DENIMMINION.description:
[gold]7 HP[/gold]. Takes unblocked attack damage for you.
When hit, grants you 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
THETAILOR-SILKMINION.title: Silk Minion
THETAILOR-SILKMINION.description:
[gold]1 HP[/gold]. Takes unblocked attack damage for you.
At the start of your turn, grants you 2 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
THETAILOR-WOOLMINION.title: Wool Minion
THETAILOR-WOOLMINION.description:
[gold]3 HP[/gold]. Takes unblocked attack damage for you.
Your first attack each turn applies 1 [gold]Weak[/gold].
